sources.title: Holy See Press Office, 7 October 2010, Eastern Church and particular-law fact sheets 01356–01357
sources.inspection: Complete 14-page PDF and parallel whole HTML acquired. Original page images 9–13 inspected. First sheet names 22 Eastern Churches plus Latin in 23 total, expressly labels Albanese sui iuris and qualifies Serbia/Montenegro. Adjacent sheet opens with 23 in Eastern-code/five-tradition scope but enumerates 6+4+3+9=22.
sources.locus: PDF pp. 9–12 (first fact sheet 01356-01.02); pp. 12–13 (adjacent sheet 01357-01.01); p. 14 closing bulletin code
sources.limitations: Dated 2010 institutional fact sheets, not legislation or a current named census. The Annuario statement is mediated by this source; no direct Annuario inspection. Preserve inconsistent adjacent-sheet total/scope. No service-book inference.

sources.title: Cardinal Leonardo Sandri, Summer School Diritto canonico orientale e statuto personale libanese, 19 July 2016; SICO 2015–2016
sources.inspection: Complete 536-page volume acquired; original pp. 264–266 and imprint PDF p. 4 inspected. Paragraph gives 6 patriarchal + 4 major archiepiscopal + 5 metropolitan + 7 other structured units + 2 without adequate structure = 24 named units (computed total, not a source-stated grand total). It omits Albania, separately names Czech Republic/Serbia/Croatia, and labels Rutena USA.
sources.locus: Printed/PDF pp. 264–266; categories pp. 265–266; imprint PDF p. 4
sources.limitations: Speech date 2016-07-19; issue 2015–2016; printed April 2018. Unit labels and scope differ from both 2010 and the same volume's November 2016 list. Crosswalk is bounded research placement, not current Church taxonomy, a canonical merger, or extinction evidence.

sources.title: Cardinal Leonardo Sandri, El Concilio y los Orientales y Notas sobre la atención de los católicos orientales en la diáspora, 15 November 2016; SICO 2015–2016
sources.inspection: Complete 536-page volume acquired; original pp. 317, 325 and imprint PDF p. 4 inspected. Named list contains 6 patriarchal + 4 major archiepiscopal + 5 metropolitan + 8 other entries = 23 (all counts computed; no subtotals or grand total printed). Includes Albanesa, combines Croacia y Serbia, and does not separately list Czech Republic. These 23 labels crosswalk to the existing 23 research slots.
sources.locus: Printed/PDF p. 317 (opening/date), p. 325 (list and footnote 21); imprint PDF p. 4
sources.limitations: Dated 15 November 2016 speech printed April 2018; not a 2026 census. Footnote 21's 2000 book and 2016 CNEWA/Annuario-derived chart remain uninspected. Preserve the contrary July 2016 unit list and Parenti 2022 omission; do not infer present Albanian classification, book reception or version counts.

sources.title: Pius XII, Inter regiones, 11 November 1939, AAS 32 (1940) 139–140
sources.inspection: Whole 650-page AAS volume acquired; both original act pages 139–140 inspected. Creates Administratio Apostolica Albaniae Australis from southern Dyrrachian territory within Elbassan, Korea, Berat, Valona, Argyrocastro; subjects it to the Oriental Congregation and gives its administrator jurisdiction over existing/future Latin and Byzantine parishes/missions and all faithful of both rites within its bounds.
sources.locus: AAS 32 (1940), printed/PDF pp. 139–140; act dated 11 November 1939 on p. 140
sources.limitations: Historical territorial constitution; act date 1939-11-11 differs from AAS volume year 1940. Does not itself adjudicate current Church ascription, create a modern CCEO sui iuris category, establish suppression or identify any celebrant book. The old territory/jurisdiction is not automatically a current statement.

sources.locus: Bulletin B0334; Nomina dell’Amministratore Apostolico dell’Albania Meridionale; item 00681-IT.01; delivery URL ends 00676.html

This delivery's URL 00676 is not the specific appointment's item number 00681.

institutional_findings.finding: Pius XII separates southern Dyrrachian territory within the civil provinces named Elbassan, Korea, Berat, Valona and Argyrocastro, creates the Apostolic Administration Albaniae Australis, subjects it to the Oriental Congregation and grants its administrator jurisdiction over existing/future Latin and Byzantine parishes/missions and all faithful of both rites within its bounds.
institutional_findings.limit: A historical territorial act with jurisdiction for both rites does not itself settle modern CCEO Church classification or personal ascription; the old boundaries and legal state are not silently made current. It identifies no celebrant book.
